verdicts.reason: A: the quote is set small and starts at an arbitrary x≈180, while the SOLSTICE logo sits centred at the top on a different axis. The glass is shrunk to a tiny figure in the corner and its sun is barely visible. There is a big dead gap between the quote mark and the quote, so the layout feels scattered. B: the quote is larger and more readable, and the glass is a strong secondary focal point, so the hierarchy is better. But the text block crowds the left edge (margin about 16px) and the attribution nearly touches the bottom. The logo is tiny and doesn't line up with the text edge. The quote mark still floats far above the text, and the glass sits above its backing circle instead of inside it.
